ZUG, Switzerland, April 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lithium Argentina AG (“ **Lithium Argentina** ” or the “ **Company** ”) ( **TSX: LAR** ) ( **NYSE: LAR** ) will release its first quarter 2026 earnings results before market open on Tuesday, May 12, 2026.


The Company will hold a webcast and conference call to discuss its first quarter 2026 results on Tuesday, May 12, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET. The webcast will be accessible on the Investor Relations section of the Company website at[https://investors.lithium-argentina.com/news-events/events.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=bQcCthAQ6M6BkuXfnwNx2eUKRwEYj6Mr8s3tvP_jFO1oHMsJ01XLcnyn63JFJ2fSVy_b28TBCGt3b1iheWOixMFytHZkboLfeo591Tm2vrOWuucHtBeUr6rxZa55eotPUjpj_JvsjVFMyLR44zA-vevxLnXcKdbyZbxc4ZM_HmS26roEzcQLIOKN83uQ8axaIpDINw0rakO243keH8BIag==)


**Webcast Details:**
Event Title: Lithium Argentina First Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call
Event Date: May 12, 2026
Start Time: 10:00 AM Eastern time (US and Canada)


**Attendee URL:**[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/712878360](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=bQcCthAQ6M6BkuXfnwNx2bHhzUDi3YvicmB9SVBxftIY6U3tn8U6tTMz_hGqqSPJDIFSFyVk6hnVg9DT743OBTPKYOE3xFC8pNjBGZfJjagIg0NFXoF5_PY_jBM4_h17WhTSEf6yWGDCNNBYIA3ERka-fsAT4JoZzox6WFsqUec=)

**ABOUT LITHIUM ARGENTINA**


Lithium Argentina, in partnership with Ganfeng, operates the Cauchari-Olaroz lithium brine operation in Argentina and is advancing additional lithium resources in the region. Lithium Argentina currently trades on the TSX and on the NYSE.
